options.title: Uber did {fact2} trips in three months. How much of your fare does it keep? 🚗
options.first_line: Uber did {fact2} rides and deliveries in three months. So how much of your fare does Uber actually keep?
options.first_frame: At night Rohan holds up his phone with the big Uber logo and a 'trip complete' fare screen, a car pulling away behind him, and a billboard over the street counting up to {fact2} trips.

options.title: How much does Uber keep from your ride home? 🚗
options.first_line: Rohan just paid Uber for his ride home. How much of that fare does Uber actually keep?
options.first_frame: Rohan steps out of a car with a big Uber logo on its door, his phone showing the fare, coins already flying out of the phone toward the car.

options.title: Your Uber fare splits in two. How much does Uber keep? 🚗
options.first_line: Your Uber fare splits in two the moment you pay. So how much of it stays with Uber?
options.first_frame: A fare receipt with the Uber logo tears in two above a car at night, one half flying to the driver's window, the other to a glowing phone.

why: It is about your own Uber fare, and the receipt tearing in two shows the question without sound, so you stay to see how big Uber's half is; A leads with a figure that is only big, and B's question is the same without the picture of the split.
